name: B10-0324/2025 (PPE) – Tackling China’s critical raw materials export restrictions
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on tackling China’s critical raw materials export restrictions
part_text:
The European Parliament is worried that China controls almost all supply of certain rare earth metals, which Europe needs for clean technology, digital products, healthcare and defence. China now requires licences to export some of these materials, which is delaying deliveries to European companies. The Parliament asks the European Commission to raise this with China, look at possible trade countermeasures, and build Europe's own supply chain, from mining to recycling. This is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- The Parliament asks the Commission to act on China's export restrictions; no law changes.
- European manufacturers depending on rare earth imports are affected.
- Next: the Commission is urged to raise this at the EU-China Summit.
